did: Made the look of the call and Playoff Delta for video, and their sound. Mochi Night, the palette the research derived from what YouTube does to colour, is now an app theme and the call's and Playoff Delta's template theme, in version 3, and the renderer is BT.709 end to end. The music bed and the six sound cues are made by our own code, the same bytes anywhere, and the owner has laid them on home. Studio's template page now lets the owner choose the mark's theme. The brand's animated open and close draw the app's own mark in the template's theme. On the way, the renderer's sound stopped losing a cue or a take on CI's ffmpeg 9, which had turned renderer pull requests red at random. Later the same day: each stage now refuses a template version newer than it knows, and the recorders fail with its words, so a stage behind its recorders can no longer draw a new week in the old look (VS1). The call and Playoff Delta have a version 4 whose open and close are the animated mark in the mark's theme, rendered by video-motion beside the stills. And the phone's status page has a row for what home is making, opening Studio's Renders page, whose bar now sweeps while home gives no share.

calls.title: The music bed's music
options: a slow major progression with pad, bass and bells
calls.why: It moves without competing with the voice, and a drone tires over eight minutes.
calls.undo: Change music-bed.ts; its sum, file name and the series that pin it move together.

calls.title: Mochi Night's accents held to contrast on the ground only
options: on the ground and on cards
calls.why: A video frame is the ground; the warning, weaker on a card, always comes with a word.
calls.undo: Measure on the surface too in videoPaletteProblems and change the warning's colour.

calls.title: Every video's colour moves to BT.709 from the next render
calls.why: Players read HD as BT.709, so every untagged video shifted a little before.
calls.undo: Revert TO_VIDEO and BT709 in plan.ts.

calls.title: The six sound cues' character, and where the promo plays them
options: synthesised cues on the dry run's beats
no cues until the owner places them
calls.why: The owner asked for sounds we make ourselves and described none; the dry run's sheet put each on a visible beat.
calls.undo: Change cues.ts, or CUE_AT in promo.ts.

calls.title: Where the status page shows home's renders
options: a row under Sending to home
calls.why: Renders are home's work for Studio, neither something this phone sends nor a send needing a hand.
calls.undo: Move renderRow's group to home and drop studio from the board's groups (C27).

left: Home renders version 4 only once its render image carries video-motion at or after #2799's merge, with a Chromium headless shell (MOTION_COMMIT, SERVER-halves), and the next www release carries #2798 and #2799 together with both pins.
The Renders bar moves by time, not steps, until the recorder reports its steps (paulgsc/server#739).
